blurb: Lakeland Hills Golf Course is located in Jackson, Michigan. Lakeland Hills offers a challenging 18-hole layout, a comfortable bar, and a banquet facility with a capacity for 200 persons. The course has a par of 72, measuring 6,401 yards from the blue tees, 6,013 yards from the white tees, and 5,070 yards from the red tees. Lakeland Hills Golf Course also features a set of gold tees for seniors.
